firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently gambled starts. The rules also allow choosing the first player randomly.
clarifications: Before play, choose two first-floor corner tiles as entrances. Each player enters through one of these at the start of their first turn; that initial move costs no action.
After a player's turn and the bouncer's turn on that floor, the next player clockwise takes a turn.
Random Finale Mode changes the finale setup, while retaining the normal starting instructions.
